fact: On 6 October 2025 the Ministry of Justice presented an action plan to the Prime Minister that includes digitisation of judicial and administrative records.
title: PRESENTACIÓN DEL PLAN DE ACCION DEL Mº DE JUSTICIA: EL PM SUBRAYA LA IMPORTANCIA DE ACERCAR LA JUSTICIA AL CIUDADANO Y CONSOLIDAR UN SISTEMA JUDICIAL MÁS EFICIENTE.
